name: fury of the frost giant
desc: You’ve manifested the icy power of frost giants, granting you the following benefits:
- Increase your Strength, Constitution, or Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
- You have resistance to cold damage.

- Frigid Retaliation: When a creature you can see hits you with an attack roll, you can use your reaction to retaliate with icy magic. The attacker takes 1d8 cold damage and must succeed on a Strength saving throw (DC 8 + your proficiency bonus + the ability modifier of the score increased by this feat) or have its speed reduced to 0 until the end of its next turn. You can use this reaction a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.
